title: Discovery of non-antiproliferative selective estrogen receptor degraders (SERDs) based on scaffold optimization of elacestrant.
authors: Lu, Yunlong; Zhao, Zhihao; Wang, Shanglong; Zheng, Tianpeng; Chen, Xuejie; Liu, Lijuan; Zhu, Yuqing; Liu, Wukun
one_liner_zh: 该研究为基于分子对接的SERD药物优化，聚焦小分子与P450代谢及ER降解，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Elacestrant, the first oral selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD), has been approved for ER positive breast cancer in 2023. Recent study showed that elacestrant has moderate pharmacokinetic property and the oral bioavailability is 11 %. In this study, we have performed docking analyses of elacestrant with different cytochrome P450 isoforms. The results indicated that tetrahydronaphthalene scaffold of elacestrant located closely to Heme iron center of P450s and might undergo rapid metabolism by CYP3A4. Therefore, we have changed the tertiary carbon atom to nitrogen atom of the scaffold to attenuate the metabolic effect. The most interesting finding is that compound B16 exhibited significant degradation of ERalpha at 5 muM but didn't show antiproliferative activity at high concentrations in MCF-7 and T47D cells. Compound B16 may serve as an ER probe to investigate ER status in ER positive breast cancer cells.
abstract_zh: Elacestrant，首个口服选择性雌激素受体降解剂（SERD），已于2023年获批用于ER阳性乳腺癌。近期研究表明，elacestrant具有中等药代动力学特性，口服生物利用度为11%。在本研究中，我们对elacestrant与不同细胞色素P450亚型进行了对接分析。结果表明，elacestrant的四氢萘骨架靠近P450s的血红素铁中心，可能被CYP3A4快速代谢。因此，我们将该骨架中的叔碳原子改为氮原子，以减弱代谢效应。最有趣的发现是，化合物B16在5 μM浓度下显著降解ERα，但在MCF-7和T47D细胞中高浓度下未表现出抗增殖活性。化合物B16可能作为ER探针，用于研究ER阳性乳腺癌细胞中的ER状态。
